sanskrit_verse: अष्टापाद्यं तु शूद्रस्य स्तेये भवति किल्विषम् । द्विरष्टापाद्यं वैश्यस्य द्वात्रिंशत् क्षत्रियस्य तु ॥
transliteration: aṣṭāpādyaṃ tu śūdrasya steye bhavati kilviṣam | dviraṣṭāpādyaṃ vaiśyasya dvātriṃśat kṣatriyasya tu ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In the act of theft, the quantum of conscious defilement incurred is eightfold for the Śūdra, sixteenfold for the Vaiśya, and thirty-twofold for the Kṣatriya.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is determined by capacity to uphold Dharma
Causation arises from deviation in consciousness, not external action
Capacity-based responsibility scales with societal role and awareness
Restoration logic aligns consequence directly with the distortion caused
Consciousness alignment is proportional to the hierarchical duty-bearing capacity
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor = Śūdra AND act = theft THEN contamination_value = 8
IF actor = Vaiśya AND act = theft THEN contamination_value = 16
IF actor = Kṣatriya AND act = theft THEN contamination_value = 32
supreme_court_application: This doctrine establishes a scalar framework for assessing transgressions based on varṇic duty-bearing capacity. The Supreme Court must recognize that the severity of misalignment is not punitive but reflective of energetic distortion requiring proportional correction within societal harmony.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that misdeeds arise from inner imbalance, not inherent evil. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential unfolding from thought to act; thus, correction follows the same sequence inwardly. Responsibility is measured by one's role-determined capacity. Non-punitive reality affirms suffering as unreal; hence, enforcement restores balance through conscious completion rather than pain.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate contamination acknowledgment ritual aligned with varṇic duty level
Assign corrective dharma cycles scaled to contamination_value
Monitor consciousness resonance until integrity reestablished
Reintegrate individual upon verified alignment with svadharma field
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored through precise alignment of consciousness, not through punishment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
